meta.name: Cover-Up
meta.description: Cover-Upexplores the investigative journalism career of Seymour Hersh, a Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist, exposing the United States’ war crimes during the Vietnam War and the secret US bombing of Cambodia, the Watergate scandal, the CIA’s program of domestic spying, and the torture and abuse of prisoners at Abu Ghraib during the war on terror and the invasion of Iraq.
